snippet.title: Silent Noise: Prologue - Unspoken Update Trailer | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Welcome back to Willow Park.

The official Unspoken Update Trailer for Silent Noise: Prologue is finally here. We are giving you a deeper look into the mystery, tension, and atmospheric nightmare lurking inside City Central Sector 32.

As this prologue serves as the official demo for Silent Noise: Chapter 1, our team at MSP Games wanted to ensure we deliver the absolute best experience possible for our community. We listened closely to your feedback, and this major update expands the world with extended playtime, brand new characters, polished cinematics, and new voiceover interactions that significantly elevate the narrative.

Mark your calendars: The Unspoken Update officially drops on September 3, 2026.

WHAT'S NEW IN THE UNSPOKEN UPDATE:

Extended Playtime: Additional areas to explore, deeper story elements, and expanded puzzles.

New Characters & Voiceover: Uncover new narrative arcs and meet unsettling figures within the park, including Villi.

Visual Direction Shift: Dynamic camera angles, higher-contrast atmospheric lighting, and reworked cutscenes.

Audio Design Polish: Layered environmental horror soundscapes paired with a synthwave score.

CONNECT WITH US:

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/msp_games.in?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsi=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==

X (Twitter): https://x.com/mspgames_in

Website: https://mspgamesofficial-studio.github.io/MSP-Games/

Discord Community: https://discord.gg/ehXqgDK3Ek

Thank you all for the incredible support as we continue building this universe. Be sure to subscribe and turn on notifications to stay up to date with our progress.

Developer: MSP Games
Genre: Psychological Horror / Mystery
